completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

active_mission.title: Continuous Hixton optimization and reality-integrity guard
active_mission.objective: Optimize the active V6 system coin-by-coin across all ten USDC markets while preserving one canonical strategy shared by isolated 10x250 diagnostics and the real shared 3x80 portfolio. Baseline checkpoint: the verified BNB-ATR120 active profile produces 864.32339131529085 USDC in the 3x80 portfolio on the 2023-09-19T10:00Z..2026-09-19T10:00Z window, and the same-window optimization baseline is 7752.3660799984835 USDC across isolated 10x250. Expand the bounded candidate neighbourhood rather than weakening validation. Only promote evidence-backed profile changes that pass train A/B, frozen validation baseline+stress and full-window coin gates, and whose assembled candidate does not reduce either the aggregate isolated 10x250 baseline/stress or the shared 3x80 baseline/stress versus the incumbent. Re-run both models and A01-A11 after any promotion.
active_mission.last_transition_reason: Owner instruction 2026-09-19: enforce evidence-led Top-K coin optimization. Repair stale Paper runtime first through the existing controlled strategy-activation path without resetting the account. Then improve 10x250 coin-by-coin, carry multiple training finalists into validation/full-3y/stress, measure each robust coin change alone in shared 3x80, and only combine changes that remain portfolio-compatible. Target is a validated 3x80 baseline above the current 864.81890017149085 USDC checkpoint without weakening validation.
constraints: Run in GitHub-hosted virtual environments; no owner laptop dependency.
The eleven cloud roles must run without OpenAI/API secrets; their default mode is deterministic verification and supervision.
Trading mode is permanently Paper-only for this project phase: real public Binance market data, simulated orders/fills, persistent Paper account state.
Never send real or testnet exchange orders and never request Binance account credentials.
Do not replace real Binance candles with synthetic market data for operational Paper evaluation; deterministic fixtures remain allowed only for unit/regression tests.

A research-only pre-listing market proxy may use real public Binance USDT candles for the same base assets only when it is explicitly labelled as proxy evidence and never presented as historical USDC liquidity or fills.
Every material extension must emit role-specific evidence rather than only a PASS flag.
A10 must reject missing/stale specialist evidence, incomplete regression coverage, or an active mission left at NEW after work has started, and route the defect into repair.
A11 must independently verify the evidence contract, A10 repair state and A09 QA gate before GOVERNANCE_PASS.

A known-safe lifecycle defect where an active mission is still NEW may be normalized automatically to IN_PROGRESS before specialist execution; no other autonomous repository mutation is implied by that repair.
Audit every active-bot occurrence of legacy USDT market symbols; historical evidence and explicit legacy-rejection guards may remain but must never become active runtime configuration.
Keep the historic USDT and fresh-start USDT/USDC references distinct; never compare a carried account path to a fresh start as if they were equivalent.

The owner-approved normal 3x80 capacity semantics supersede the older one-slot-per-symbol execution assumption for V6: use all free slots on currently valid ranked candidates, including repeat allocation to the strongest candidate when fewer distinct candidates exist.
Do not fabricate additional strategy signals. Multiple slots assigned to one signal are multiple 80-USDC capacity tranches of one signal cycle and must be reported as such.
Repair only proven implementation/configuration/data/reporting defects; do not tune the strategy merely to force a historical target.
Keep failed candidates, losing windows and contradictory evidence visible.
If fresh evidence cannot distinguish a defect from a modelling choice, document the exact unresolved question for the owner instead of guessing.
After any repair, rerun all eleven roles before completion is claimed.
Remove the persistent 20-percent portfolio drawdown halt from active V6 Paper and shared-portfolio backtest entry gating; keep drawdown calculation and reporting.
Keep the 5-percent UTC-day loss pause, emergency stop, cash limits, exchange filters, stale-data and execution safety gates unchanged.
Optimize coins only through explicit versioned candidate profiles; use training windows for selection and a separate validation window for acceptance.

A candidate that improves one isolated coin is not accepted solely on that result; the assembled ten-coin candidate set must be rerun in the shared 3x80 portfolio with identical costs, window and execution semantics.
The same canonical profile map must feed 10x250 isolated backtests, 3x80 shared portfolio, Paper runtime and UI. No shadow profile map or backtest-only override may be activated.

Audit every DMS file. Current normative statements must use USDC, ranked_repeat 3x80 semantics, separate position-cycle versus slot-trade counts, no permanent 20-percent portfolio halt, and canonical 10x250-to-3x80 profile propagation. Preserve dated historical evidence as historical rather than rewriting its original results.
Never select one global candidate variant for all ten coins. Each symbol compares its own bounded candidate catalog against its own current incumbent profile.
A per-coin challenger must not replace the incumbent if the full three-year 10x250 result is worse under baseline costs or stress costs, even if a shorter validation slice looked better.

The assembled active-patch candidate must pass a shared 3x80 non-regression gate. If 3x80 ending equity falls versus the current profile map under baseline or stress costs, do not activate the assembled set; isolate the conflicting coin changes, revert them to incumbent as needed, and rerun.
Keep rejected isolated winners visible as research evidence. The active canonical map contains only portfolio-compatible per-coin improvements.

The shared portfolio is the authoritative main-bot acceptance model; currently 250 USDC with 3x80 USDC, but later user-selected slot counts and per-slot notionals must reuse the same canonical profile map and allocation engine.
The 10x250 batch is diagnostic only: ten isolated 250-USDC accounts, one per symbol, never a claim that the main bot owns 2,500 USDC.
Per-coin optimization must explain why losing trades occur and test bounded causal hypotheses for that symbol; BTC parameters must not be assumed suitable for ETH or any other market.

Reality-integrity rule: every material evidence item must be attributable to REAL_PUBLIC_BINANCE_DATA, HISTORICAL_SAME_BASE_PROXY, MODEL_ASSUMPTION, SYNTHETIC_TEST_FIXTURE, or UNVERIFIED. Never blur these categories.

Every active strategy parameter must be traceable to the owner Pine/reference, the current incumbent profile, or a documented bounded candidate search with stored selection evidence. No freehand parameter invention is allowed.

All README files must state whether they are current normative guidance or historical/research evidence. Historical results remain unchanged but cannot override the current USDC/ranked_repeat/no-permanent-halt contract.

Current normative documentation must not contain active-sounding USDT, one_per_symbol, or permanent 20-percent portfolio-halt requirements. Historical dated sections may retain them only with an explicit historical boundary.

Backtest performance claims must be reproducible from immutable manifest/metrics/trades/equity evidence. If raw evidence is missing, label the claim UNVERIFIED rather than reconstructing a favorable number.
Optimization may seek more valid trades and better net results, but may not add hindsight-only conditions, leak validation/holdout information into selection, or hide losing coins/trades.

10x250 and 3x80 must use exactly the same active per-symbol strategy hashes after integration. A profile change that does not propagate is a defect; a propagated change that is blocked by slot competition must be explained from the shared signal/fill path.
Download-ready status requires fresh preflight plus real dashboard E2E and a full A01-A11 run after the latest documentation/code patch, with A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS.

DMS 10 and DMS 20 are the canonical future-operations roadmap for staged automatic updates, rollback, restart/reconciliation, watchdogs and optional external notifications such as WhatsApp; roadmap text must never be presented as already implemented.

Future operations automation must not reintroduce a permanent portfolio drawdown halt or any other performance gate that silently freezes the trading strategy. Technical safety halts remain separate and evidence-based.

Automatic software updates must be staged, verified, backed up and rollback-capable; strategy/profile changes must never be silently activated by the software updater and must still pass 10x250, shared 3x80 and A01-A11 gates.

The central backtests/README.md is the persistent learning journal. After every material optimization cycle, preserve prior findings and append per-coin baseline, loss patterns, hypotheses, candidate diffs, train/validation/stress results, accept/reject rationale, shared-3x80 impact and immutable evidence references.
Do not erase rejected candidates from the central backtest journal; failed experiments are required negative evidence and must remain available to prevent repeated bad searches.
Do not weaken train/validation/stress gates merely to exceed the current 864.323391 3x80 checkpoint.
Use one canonical V6 profile map for Paper, 10x250 isolated diagnostics and 3x80 shared portfolio; no separate optimized strategy for one report mode.
Any assembled promotion must be non-regressive versus the incumbent in aggregate isolated baseline/stress AND shared-portfolio baseline/stress.
Training selection must preserve a bounded Top-K shortlist per coin; failure of rank 1 in validation/full-3y must not automatically discard robust rank 2+ candidates.
Validation and holdout results may eliminate a candidate but may never be used to silently choose a different candidate without that reselection being explicitly modelled and revalidated.
Every robust per-coin challenger must be tested alone against the incumbent nine-coin map in shared 3x80 baseline and stress before multi-coin assembly.
Portfolio-compatible combinations must be built only from marginal 3x80 non-regressive candidates; record interaction deltas when combined effects differ from individual effects.

Current shared-portfolio checkpoint to beat is 864.81890017149085 USDC baseline on the latest verified three-year window; any promoted profile must also preserve or improve shared-portfolio stress versus 771.2683414347478 USDC on the same window/cost model.
Repair the current Paper strategy-version mismatch only with the explicit audited activation path that preserves history; no automatic fresh-start reset is allowed.
acceptance: All eleven roles participate in every material guard run and emit fresh role-specific evidence for their assigned layer.
All eleven default cloud roles execute without OpenAI or Binance private API credentials.
A01 validates mission state, requirements and Paper-only invariants before specialist evidence can be accepted.

A02 runs the owner slot-capacity regression and verifies that one ranked candidate can consume three free slots, two candidates consume 2+1, and three candidates consume 1+1+1 while preserving the same signal rules.
A02 records unique completed position cycles separately from completed slot-equivalent round trips so repeated slots are not hidden in the trade count.
A03 verifies that Paper and shared-portfolio backtest use the same active V6 slot-allocation policy and preserve persisted slot_count without resetting the Paper account.
A04 verifies that UI/report wording does not present position-cycle count as the complete slot-trade count when repeated slots are active.
A05 continuously verifies Paper ledger integrity and freshness and fails on stale state.
A06 executes the full integration/regression suite after changes and exposes failures rather than masking them.
A07 verifies all ten real public Binance USDC markets and current public candle access without private credentials and records the actual common-history start imposed by listing/data availability.
A09 performs fresh full Python and UI QA and issues QA_PASS only after A01-A08 and A10 are clean.
A10 verifies the mission-specific evidence matrix, detects lifecycle/evidence drift, and reports repair_required=false only when every required specialist category is actually covered.
A11 independently rechecks the mission-specific evidence matrix, QA_PASS, A10 repair state and Paper-only contract before GOVERNANCE_PASS.
An active mission cannot silently remain NEW once specialist work begins; the lifecycle guard either repairs the known-safe NEW-to-IN_PROGRESS transition or the run fails closed.
The 10x250 isolated diagnostic remains separately labelled and is not misrepresented as the same account/risk model as 3x80.

A clearly labelled three-year continuity research run evaluates the current USDC strategy over the full historical period using real same-base-asset public market proxy data where USDC listing history is unavailable, while explicitly stating that the proxy is not historical USDC liquidity or execution evidence.
A08 verifies that the 5-percent daily pause remains active while the persistent 20-percent portfolio drawdown halt no longer blocks entries.

The real three-year 3x80 dashboard portfolio run and 10x250 isolated run use the same report window and expose per-coin isolated trade counts, portfolio position cycles, slot-trades, ending equity, max drawdown and blocked-entry reasons.
The repaired 3x80 three-year run reports zero MAX_DRAWDOWN_20_PERCENT blocked entries and no persistent risk_halted_at_utc.
A01-A11 all rerun after the repair; A09 must issue QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS before the patch is considered downloadable.
No real-money order path is enabled and no automatic merge occurs.

For each of the ten coins, produce current baseline diagnostics: completed trades, wins/losses, realized PnL, return, max drawdown, holding-time/loss-pattern evidence and blocked-signal reasons where applicable.
Per-coin candidate selection uses training data only; validation and stress results are reported after selection and cannot trigger silent reselection.
The assembled ten-coin candidate profile set is versioned once and used unchanged by a fresh 10x250 batch and fresh 3x80 shared-portfolio run on the same report window.
A parity proof records the exact per-symbol parameter/policy hashes used by both 10x250 and 3x80 and fails if they differ.

If the 3x80 result is unchanged after a profile change, evidence must show whether the modified coin produced an identical shared-portfolio signal/fill path because of slot competition; otherwise treat the unchanged result as a parity defect.
All 27 DMS files are scanned; every current contradictory normative statement is repaired, while historical dated sections remain explicitly historical.
After code/profile/DMS changes, rerun the real 10x250, real 3x80, full Python/UI regression and A01-A11 with A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS.
Regression evidence explicitly records the rejected 2026-09-19 candidate: current 3x80 about 750.58 USDC versus candidate about 594.60 USDC; it must not be treated as an accepted patch.
SOL regression is guarded: a candidate that changes the full isolated baseline from about 1521.88 USDC to about 1007.40 USDC must be rejected in favor of the incumbent.
For every symbol, evidence records incumbent full-3y baseline/stress versus challenger full-3y baseline/stress and the final per-symbol decision.
The final integrated mixed profile map must have 3x80 baseline and stress ending equity greater than or equal to the current canonical map before any activation/version promotion is allowed.

If an individually improved coin harms shared 3x80 because of slot competition or signal timing, its isolated winner remains research-only and the active integrated profile for that coin stays at the incumbent unless another compatible candidate is found.
Evidence explicitly labels 3x80 as the main shared target system and 10x250 as the per-coin diagnostic laboratory for the same strategy.
For every symbol, the cycle reports incumbent versus challenger trade count, wins/losses, return, max drawdown, worst-loss examples and final accept/reject rationale.
After assembling accepted per-coin profiles, exactly the same profile hashes must be used in a fresh 10x250 batch and shared 3x80 portfolio run; no backtest-only profile override is permitted.
The integrated shared 3x80 baseline and stress results are the final strategy gate; isolated improvements that damage the main bot are retained only as research evidence.
A01 scans every README and all DMS documents for active-vs-historical contradictions and records every repaired or intentionally historical occurrence.
A02 verifies 10x250 per-coin diagnostics against raw trades and proves that any proposed parameter change comes from a bounded documented candidate catalog rather than an invented value.
A03 proves Paper and backtest read the same canonical profile map and that no research-only override can silently enter runtime.
A04 verifies UI/report wording distinguishes real market data, historical proxy data, simulated fills/model costs and synthetic test fixtures where surfaced.
A06 recomputes representative metrics from raw trade/equity artifacts and fails if headline totals cannot be reproduced.
A07 verifies public Binance provenance for operational/backtest market data and confirms synthetic fixtures are confined to deterministic tests.
A08 audits every active V6 parameter/policy for provenance and rejects hindsight-only or undocumented risk/strategy additions.
A09 issues QA_PASS only after current documentation, raw-evidence reproducibility, 10x250/3x80 parity and regression suites are clean.
A11 independently issues GOVERNANCE_PASS only if there are no unsupported profit/performance claims, no hidden stale current rules and no missing evidence classifications.
All backtests/v2-v9 README files carry an explicit historical/research boundary so obsolete risk/quote/slot rules cannot be interpreted as current.

The current root README and DMS 02/04/06 agree on USDC, shared 250 with baseline 3x80 ranked_repeat, no permanent portfolio drawdown halt, 10x250 diagnostic role, and per-coin-to-shared integration gating.
A01 verifies DMS 10/20 future-roadmap wording is clearly separated from current implemented capabilities and that no roadmap item reintroduces the removed permanent portfolio drawdown halt.
A02 maintains backtests/README.md as the coin-by-coin research ledger and verifies every recorded performance claim against raw manifest/metrics/trades/equity evidence.
Every material 10x250 optimization run updates the central backtest journal for all ten coins, including unchanged incumbents and rejected challengers rather than only winners.
A03 verifies every accepted per-coin profile propagates through the same canonical profile map into both 10x250 and shared 3x80; any mismatch is a defect.
A05 reviews future 24x7 roadmap requirements for restart, reconciliation, backup/restore and watchdog observability without claiming them implemented before tests exist.
A09 and A11 reject any optimization or future-operations claim that lacks reproducible evidence, hides a rejected candidate, or confuses roadmap with current functionality.
Optimization evidence covers all ten USDC coins and records training winner, validation outcome, full-window incumbent/challenger metrics and whether each profile was accepted.
Before promotion, the assembled candidate must pass an aggregate gate: 10x250 baseline/stress and 3x80 baseline/stress are each >= incumbent, with at least one material improvement.
After any promotion, a fresh real dashboard E2E and A01-A11 swarm must pass on the exact active profile/config version before download.

A03/A05 provide fresh evidence that the Paper ledger strategy version equals the active canonical V6 version after controlled activation, with prior history retained and no silent fresh-account reset.
For each coin, optimization evidence records the ordered Top-K training shortlist and validation/full-3y baseline+stress outcome for each finalist.
For each robust finalist, evidence records a single-coin marginal shared-3x80 baseline/stress delta versus the incumbent map.
The final combination search uses only individually portfolio-compatible finalists and records interaction effects before any promotion.

A promoted final map must exceed 864.81890017149085 USDC shared-3x80 baseline and be non-regressive versus 771.2683414347478 USDC shared-3x80 stress on the exact same report window, while aggregate isolated 10x250 baseline/stress remain non-regressive.
XRP evidence includes loss-cluster/regime analysis explaining the dominant losing-trade patterns rather than only another blind parameter sweep.
SOL incumbent is retained unless a challenger passes training, validation, full-3y, stress and marginal shared-3x80 gates.
BTC evidence explicitly tests whether smaller parameter shifts can retain isolated improvement without the previously observed shared-slot timing regression.
active_mission.download_snapshot_rule: A download snapshot is current only when it contains the cleaned README/DMS contract, passes fresh preflight, and retains the last proven trading-code E2E invariants. The ongoing A01-A11 integrity/optimization mission continues after download without silently changing the user's local copy.

paper_repair_first: A03/A05 must resolve the current Paper strategy-version mismatch through the explicit audited activation mechanism; no silent reset, no fresh 250-USDC account, no real/testnet orders.
A05 must become fresh and ledger-integrity clean before final QA/Governance.
research_sequence: For every symbol rank more than one training candidate; retain a bounded Top-K shortlist rather than discarding rank 2+ when the top candidate later fails.
Run frozen validation baseline/stress and full-three-year baseline/stress for every shortlisted candidate without reselection from validation.
For every robust shortlisted coin candidate, run a marginal shared-3x80 test changing only that symbol while the other nine remain incumbent.
Reject any coin candidate that improves isolated 10x250 but reduces shared-3x80 baseline or stress.
Combine only individually portfolio-compatible coin changes, then rerun aggregate 10x250 baseline/stress and shared-3x80 baseline/stress with identical profile hashes.

Prioritize ADA, AVAX, BNB and DOGE fine-neighbour searches; perform explicit loss-cluster/regime analysis for XRP; preserve SOL incumbent unless a challenger passes all gates; use BTC as a slot-timing conflict case and search smaller compatible changes.
